narrative: After the shot I had flu like symptoms and stayed in bed for 48 hours. The first day I didn't take any medication, but I did take medication on the second day. I slept through it the first day. Then around 11/15/2022, I started getting sick with what seemed like an upper respiratory infection. Then it turned into chest congestion with head congestion. Then it turned into a sinus infection and all these symptoms occurred at the same time. I never had a fever. I tested twice for COVID-19 and both were negative. During this time, I had also taken 2 weeks worth of MUCINEX to try and combat this before calling the doctor. When I went to see my doctor, I went to get a chest x-ray and I realized I needed something to combat this. I was given a steroid, 8 day course of prednisone. I was also given doxycycline for 20 days. I felt well for exactly 2 days, 48 hours. That was around 01/01 and 01/02 where I felt well. I had no chest congestion, no wheezing, no post nasal drip. Around 01/03/2023, the symptoms started again and it's progressively getting worse up to today. Today, I have wheezing, coughing, a possible sinus infection/congestion and post nasal drip. I'm coughing so bad that it's in the upper bronchial tract. There's thick mucus that has been choking me. When I wheeze bad, I start coughing really badly and I can only force something to come up a couple times a day. According to my tests, no COVID-19 and no fever.

narrative: The patient is a 64-year-old white male with complicated medical history.  He was initially admitted to Stonecrest on December 9th.  His course was significant for hypoxic respiratory failure, influenza A infection, and pneumonia.  He was given antibiotics.  He did not want intubation.    On January 6th, he was transferred to Select for further evaluation and management.  He required high levels supplemental oxygen with Vapotherm.  He was placed on BiPAP.  Antibiotics were continued.  DNR status was confirmed.  On January 8th, he expressed a desire to transition to comfort care.  Comfort care orders were placed.  He was pronounced dead at 12:47 p.m.  Family was at the bedside.
